name: Research Project
description: Synthesis docs, sources, weekly reading. Maintains a synthesis doc, a sources index, and recurring summaries. Recommended add-ons: a web search MCP and a Citations skill.

starter_tasks.details: Capture the research question, current best understanding, and open gaps. The agent keeps this up to date as new sources are added.
Ask the agent for new sources on the topic and a 1-paragraph TL;DR of each. Schedule this task weekly to keep the synthesis fresh.
